rule.name: SpringTransactionalReadOnlyWrite
rule.message: Put @Transactional without readOnly on this method, or map the loaded entity to a DTO if the change only shapes the response. A write inside a read-only transaction fails or is silently dropped, and so is a change to an entity loaded in it.
